That means retrieval systems over large document corpora that arrive as inconsistent PDFs, scans and HTML. Take AI features from vague problem statement through to specified, built, evaluated and deployed.

Build evaluation harnesses, golden datasets and regression suites, and feed real production failures back into them.
Own cost and latency as first-class constraints: model routing, caching, batching, context economy, fallbacks when a provider degrades.
